notes: S4.2 states that with en=1, serial_out equals serial_in delayed by WIDTH-1 clocks, but the property omits the required non-reset condition and the uninterrupted enabled shifts needed to propagate the sampled bit to the MSB. For example, rst=1 and en=1 causes reset to override the shift, so that serial_in is not accepted and need not appear at serial_out WIDTH-1 clocks later. S4.3 similarly omits the reset condition for hold behavior, but S4.2 is the earliest substantive error. Final RTL is correct and passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
